visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male subject wearing a white graphic t-shirt depicting Mount Fuji stands in a brightly lit, modern bathroom. He looks into the camera lens with a neutral expression, preparing to demonstrate a grooming product while positioned against a background of white tiles and a visible doorway leading to another room. (2) He holds up a small, rectangular white wax strip to the camera, showcasing its semi-transparent texture and the branding printed on the edge. He examines the strip closely with a focused gaze, emphasizing the object's specific physical details and intended use for the audience. (3) The subject applies the wax strips to both of his ears, pressing them firmly against the skin behind the auricle. He looks at himself in the camera, ensuring the strips are well-adhered, while maintaining a calm but slightly apprehensive facial expression before the removal phase. (4) He suddenly pulls the wax strip off his right ear, resulting in a dramatic facial contortion characterized by squinted eyes and a wide-open mouth. He then repeats this with the other ear, displaying an intense physical reaction through tensed facial muscles and quick, forceful hand movements. (5) In the final moments, he displays the used wax strips to the lens, showing the captured hairs and adhesive residue. His face remains tense with a lingering expression of discomfort and humor, while he gestures with his hands to emphasize both the effectiveness and pain of the process.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An upbeat, jazz-inspired background music track starts, featuring a moderate tempo with prominent piano melodies and bright brass instrument textures. The recording is studio-clean with no initial human vocal presence or ambient noise, establishing a cheerful and energetic acoustic atmosphere. (2) A sharp, high-intensity male yell punctuates the mix, characterized by a sudden rise in volume and a strained vocal quality indicating a reaction to a physical sensation. This vocalization is the primary foreground acoustic event while the bouncy BGM continues steadily. (3) A second, even louder and more prolonged male vocal outburst occurs, exhibiting high emotional arousal and dramatic pitch variability. The BGM maintains its rhythmic drive, creating a stark contrast between the lighthearted musical tone and the subject's audible distress signals throughout the demonstration.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Preparation -> Painful Execution -> Result Display
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to humorously demonstrate the effectiveness and inherent physical discomfort of using specialized wax strips for ear hair removal. By contrasting cheerful background music with genuine, exaggerated pained reactions, the creator engages viewers through relatable grooming struggles and sensory entertainment.
